OriginalEnglish: Y-You say that I...<FH> You believe I would...<FH>
Hm. I see that you mean to prolong this shameless charade.
But I know the truth of your betrayal.
Ten days ago, on the night of his death, I saw you<MV>slithering from his chambers like the snake you are.
So, you see...when we found this beside his body, it came as no surprise.
Tell me. Do you deny it now<FH>
Do you deny that this is a feather from your magnificent crown<FH>
B... But I...
I did not, I would not, kill your father<FG>
I swear it<FG>
You dare lie so brazenly to my face<FG><FH>
You who claim to be a leader of men<FG><FH>
SILENCE<FG>
Prince Cesar.
If I understand you correctly, it was ten days ago that your honoured father met his unfortunate end<FH>
Indeed. Exactly ten days this evening.
If that is indeed the case, I can confirm that our friend the King of Harba cannot possibly be the culprit.
What do you mean<FG><FH>
Why, that very evening, a feast was held to celebrate the founding of Harba.
The King here was kind enough to welcome me as a guest...
and he did me the inestimable honour of remaining by my side throughout.
I doubt that even the most cunning of murderers
could have stolen away from me, travelled to Dunisia,
committed such a crime and returned unmissed.
So you see...the vengeance you crave is not to be found in Harba.
I suspect that, rather than it having been the true King of Harba you saw, it was another.
One bent on seeing him take the blame for this most despicable of deeds.
You mean that I...
I have been deceived...<FH>
That his murderer was...<FH>
Well, that makes me quite the fool.
Quite the gullible fool indeed.
Led a merry dance by my enemies, and into all-out war, no less...
I take full responsibility for my actions.
Your Radiance...
My life is forfeit.
Hold on a minute<FG>
Cesar<FG>
How exactly is you getting your stupid head cut off going to solve anything<FG><FH>
He's right<FG>
And besides<MV>how can you bear to not find out<FH>
Don't you want to know who's really behind all this<FH>
Hey...
Come with us. We'll find the real murderer together<FG>
Your Radiance.
Our young friends are correct. The Prince must not be punished.
What will it benefit us<FH>
It cannot bring back that which has been lost.
Better that he live.
That he seek out and apprehend his father's killer.
That he help eliminate the source of that which led him down the path of war.
But Sire<FG>
Prince Cesar.
Let us seek out your father's killer together.
There are those who clearly care about you deeply.
Do this for them, if not for yourself.
My Lord...
Ha<FG>
Not so big and scary now, are you<FH>
Spare me, please... Must you shout about everything<FH>
Would it not behove you to be a little more graceful in victory<FH>
Oh, graceful in victory, eh<FH>
Maybe. But it might BEHOVE you to stop trying to be so superior and celebrate<FG>
I know you want to<FG>
Hm...
You don't know the first thing about me, little boy.
We grown-ups know that keeping a cool head is the true mark of manhood.
Stop it<FG>
You can argue about who's the biggest show-off later<FG>
We need to get moving<FG>
What she said<FG>
The longer we hang around in this horrible, smelly place, the more likely we are to<MV>
Really<FH>
What is it NOW<FG><FH>
There's something coming towards us<FG>
Uh-oh<FG> He must have called some of his friends<FG>
They're here<FG>
Huh<FG><FH>
Huh<FH> None of your heads flew off when we hit ya<FG>
These skinny little runts must be tougher than they look.
Huh, Terry<FH>
They better be. I wanna have some fun before we finish this.
What's going on<FH>
You two are...human...aren't you<FH>
You bet we are<FG>
Still, that don't mean we ain't takin' sides with our scaly pal here, 'n' everythin' like that.
If you're gonna hurt our buddies, then we're gonna hurt you<FG>
Come get some<FG>
You know, I'm almost impressed.
Now come here and<MV>
You maggots have got guts<FG>
Alright, time out, time out<FG>
I think we've seen enough<FG>
Hey, what are you doing<FH>
Can't you see I'm just getting warmed up<FH>
Ah, c'mon, bud<FG>
I said we seen enough, and we have.
You and me both know these ain't the ones we're looking for.
Huh. I guess they're not.
The ones you're looking for<FH>
That'd be...
the people who hurt your monster friends, right<FH>
So, uh...what exactly's been going on<FH>
Hah...
It's kind of a long story, but...
Old scaly green here<MV>
he tells us a bunch of his monster pals have just up and disappeared.
And where did they go<FH>
Well, that there's the weird part<MV>ain't nobody in these woods knows nothin' about it.
Thing is, accordin' to our buddy, some human was snoopin' around just before.
So we figured<MV>maybe it was this human.
Maybe they were behind the Case of the Quittin' Critters.
And that's why<MV>
Why they thought we were up to no good. It all makes sense now.
So we look like monster kidnappers to you, do we<FH>
Well, that's charming<FG>
Don't take it personal, little lady<FG>
We're sorrier'n sorry, and then some<FG>
But what's the story with you and the monsters<FH>
How come they didn't attack you in the first place<FH>
What do you mean<FH> They attacked us good when we first got here<FG>
And Terry<MV>that's this guy<MV>
him and me, we showed 'em who's boss<FG>
But then, the monsters<MV>don't ask me why<MV>they kinda took a likin' to old Terry here.
Then I guess I kinda took a likin' to the little guys too.
So we thought maybe we'd stick around, spend a little quality time with our new buddies.
Well, that's quite a story<FG>
The monsters in these woods have a reputation for being all but untameable.
It's always been that way.
Monsters get along with me better than most.
But never mind that<MV>wanna tell us where we are<FH>
This isn't our world, that much I'm sure of.
Say what<FH> You serious<FG><FH>
We are near the border of the Kingdom of Ingenia.
I take it that you have never heard of such a place<FH>
Ingenia...<FH>
Nope. Can't say as I have.
Now you mention it, ever since we arrived in these woods, I don't know why, but...
I've been findin' it kinda hard to get my bearings.
That sounds like the exact same thing that happened to Torneko and the others.
So...we've got two more visitors from other worlds on our hands, eh<FH>
Just as I thought, huh<FH>
I ain't too sure I get this whole thing, but...
You're sayin' we're kinda stranded here and...
some of the guys in your little posse...
they're stranded here too...or somethin' like that<FH>
Yes, that's it.
Well then, you better let us tag along for the ride<FG>
Can't stay holed up here in the forest forever, huh<FH>
And besides, you guys must know a thing or two about this world.
The monsters who went AWOL, the place they went AWOL to<MV>you can help us figure it all out.
Huh, Terry<FH>
Sure, why not.
We'll be better off with people from this world to show us around.
Maybe we found them for a reason.
And you'll be doing us a favour coming along too.
Things have been far from peaceful lately.
The more of us there are, the merrier<FG>
You got yourselves a deal<FG>
Alright, let's saddle up and ship out<FG>
Oh, I'm Carver.
And you already know Terry.
Nice meetin' you all<FG>
This guy's gonna be pretty sore at us for leavin' him on his lonesome.
Better skedaddle before he wakes up, eh<FH>
Wow, look at all this weird stuff.
Is that thing powered by magic or something<FH>
Probably.
Ingenia's famous for its magical inventions, after all.
Indeed.
Spellcraft runs in these people's veins.
The Ingenian royal family have been powerful sorcerers for generations.
Their reputation brought wizards here from all over the world, and the city has been a hive of enchanters ever since.
Hmm. A whole city full of wizards, huh<FH>
That could spell trouble, if you know what I mean.
Don't worry.
It's not like we came here looking for a fight or anything.
Should be plain sailing.
Heh, that is unless our cool, calm and collected friend here decides to try and do the talking for us.
Hmph. You have nothing to fear on that front.
If my father's killer is to be found here, I will raze this city to the ground.
There will not be a single wizard left to worry us.
Mind your tongue, Cesar<FG>
If that was a joke, it was in poor taste.
We're almost on the doorstep of the palace.
What do you think an Ingenian soldier would do if he heard you<MV>
Okay...
What's going on<FH>
Nothing good.
Seems like Ingenian soldiers have excellent hearing...
Let us goo<FG> I order you to release us<FG>
Straight through the city gates and into a prison cell, eh<FH>
Well, I suppose you can't always expect a warm welcome.
I know you want revenge and everything, Cesar...but do you have to go shouting about it on every street corner<FH>
Whatever happened to being a cool-headed grown-up, eh<FH>
Hm.
I'm trying to remain calm, believe me.
Really<FH>
Your bickering's already got us locked up<FG>
Take the hint and shut it, will you<FG><FH>
Well, now...
I was just after thinking this whole thing's a little fishy, so.
D'ye really think it's on account o' just a few loose words that we're all locked up down here<FH>
Yeah, it does all seem a bit much...
Those soldiers who brought us in...
I could be wrong...but I get the feeling they'd been following us for a while.
Ever since we reached the city, in fact.
I don't think it was your big mouth that put us here.
I think they were expecting us.
Really...<FH> So does that mean...
they think we've done something bad or something<FH>
I guess so...
But what could be bad enough to make them lock us up like this<FH>
The Queen will have the answers.
We need to speak to her.
She'll help us solve this little mystery.
Shhh<FG>
You lot<FG> Someone comin' this way<FG>
There you all are.
Meena, girl<FG>
Meena<FG> Meena, is it really you<FH>
Why, Torneko<FG>
So you are down here after all.
Just as the cards predicted...
Sure, I'm here...
And I've only gone and got meself locked up again.
Seems we've rubbed the Queen up the wrong way<FG>
I've a knack with these royal ladies<FG>
Tell me, dear friend<MV>
have you by any chance seen my sister<FH>
If the fates are to be believed, she is somewhere in this city too.
Have we seen young Maya, you ask<FH>
Oh, I'd love to say yes, my girl, but we've seen precious little but the inside of this here cell since we landed in town.
One thing's for certain, though<MV>ye'll not be findin' her down here.
That's a shame...
And after I went to the trouble...of stealing the keys and everything...
Hey, Torneko.
Are you two...old friends<FH>
...Oh<FG> Sure, I'd forget me head if it wasn't screwed on<FG>
This here's me ole pal Meena.
We did a little adventurin' together back in our own world, so we did.
She's only the best fortune teller a feller could ever hope to meet<FG>
Between her and her dazzling dancer of a sister, they're quite the pair o' celebrities, you know<FG>
Oh, Torneko<MV>you will give your friends the wrong idea.
It is Maya who is the celebrity, not I.
It's Meena...right<FH>
You're looking for your sister, you say.
Well, we've got some important business with the Queen.
I bet if anyone knows where your sister is it'll be her. So why not<MV>
So why not let us out and we'll go and see her<FG>
